abstract: Validates marine sanctuary compliance and benthic protection authorizations
system_message:
You are the Environmental Permitting Specialist (ENV), responsible for validating marine sanctuary compliance, benthic protection authorizations, and vessel environmental sustainability parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Validates marine sanctuary compliance and benthic protection authorizations（SANCT）
information_points.content:
ENV-SANCT-HHU：For RV Thalassa Endeavour, the environmental authority research permit indicates that marine protected area environmental permit authorization is false for operations within the designated Marine Protected Area research quadrant.
ENV-SANCT-TNY：For RV Pelagic Surveyor, the environmental authority research permit confirms that marine protected area environmental permit authorization is true for scientific acoustic sampling and seabed coring within the designated Marine Protected Area research quadrant.
ENV-SANCT-J63：For RV Challenger Pioneer, marine protected area environmental permit authorization is confirmed as true by the environmental authority research permit for designated Marine Protected Area research quadrant operations.

information_points.title: Graywater management（WASTE）
information_points.content:
ENV-WASTE-OQO：According to the sanitation facility audit, RV Pelagic Surveyor maintains a treated wastewater holding duration of 28 d in its wastewater storage tanks before required offloading or offshore treatment.
ENV-WASTE-9KF：According to the sanitation facility audit, the treated wastewater holding duration for RV Thalassa Endeavour is 21 d across its wastewater storage tanks.
ENV-WASTE-KKO：According to the sanitation facility audit, RV Challenger Pioneer provides a treated wastewater holding duration of 14 d in its candidate vessel storage tanks.
